title: Design Guidelines
slide_intent: Introduce the institution through its signature. A reader can associate the manual with the mark before encountering any rules.
strategic_value: The large seal on a dark green field can establish the umbrella identity that the six venue identities will sit beneath.
demonstration: A white circular Sheffield Museums mark occupies the center of a dark green page. The book title runs vertically at the left edge.
practical_value: Use the cover as a reference for an institutional piece where the umbrella mark should have first read.

content_islands.name: Vertical title
content_islands.spec: Set Design Guidelines in white near the left margin, reading from bottom to top.

content_islands.name: Institutional seal
content_islands.spec: Center the white circular mark at large scale. Preserve the space around its lettering and the interlocking shapes in its center.
